categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies depends/packages/sqlite.mk to pass -DSQLITE_SECURE_DELETE to SQLite builds.
categories.rationale: The change adds a compile flag to SQLite's depends recipe. It is a minor dependency build configuration update with no wider impact on build system integrity or CI.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes SQLite wallet database PRAGMA handling in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp and removes WalletDatabase::Rewrite in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Overwritten sensitive records, including master encryption keys during passphrase changes, persist in unallocated database free pages. Enabling secure_delete by default directly eliminates key residue on disk for SQLite wallets.
